article_scope.purpose: compare RCTD and Cell2location on the same six freshly simulated and hexagonally aggregated expression inputs
article_scope.artifact_policy: validated evidence retained at the scientific stop; the changed headline direction blocks a canonical claim pending author decision

observed_target_covariates: no biological target dataset is used
low-resolution spots are hexagonal aggregates of the same fresh FEAST cell simulation for both methods
known proportions are derived from exact simulated assignments

scoring.expression_input: the same fresh expression matrix is used by RCTD and Cell2location by construction
scoring.spots: exact named positive-library spot support for both methods
scoring.cell_types: exact common named support plus explicit __other__ residual mass
scoring.zero_library_spots: recorded per pair and excluded from both methods symmetrically

rng.requirement: method-effective seeds and exact simulation/method hashes are bound in the completed manifests and provenance

solver.method_gate: all six RCTD and six Cell2location jobs completed on identical expression matrices
solver.scoring_gate: predictions and truth were joined by stable spot ID and validated on common named support plus __other__

fallback_policy.missing_prediction: fatal to the complete comparison; never substitute ground truth
fallback_policy.missing_cell_type: use only the declared common-support residual policy and report support coverage
fallback_policy.headline_change: triggered: Pearson and RMSE winner directions changed, so the workflow stopped for direct author review

evidence_binding.support_rule: common named cell types plus __other__ residual mass
evidence_binding.zero_library_disposition: recorded by pair and excluded from both methods scoring

claim_limits: validated numerical evidence does not authorize RCTD superiority, a method ranking, or a winner claim
the historical JSD/Pearson/RMSE winner directions RCTD/Cell2location/Cell2location changed to RCTD/RCTD/RCTD
no publication table or figure is authorized at the scientific stop
do not substitute truth for missing predictions
Cell2location uses NumPy 2.2.6, unsupported by FEAST; FEAST was not imported in that worker
zero-library exclusions and common named support plus __other__ must accompany any future description
decision_required: authors must review the Pearson and RMSE direction changes before any publication integration
remove or explicitly narrow the comparative claim; do not convert the fresh means into a superiority statement
reconcile exact common-support, __other__, zero-library exclusions, and the external Cell2location environment with the manuscript
